onboarding.age: You must be at least 16, or your country's age of digital consent if it's higher.
onboarding.card_lead: Each taf works within a Card you issue: what it may do, with which app, and how much. Past it, it asks you.
onboarding.control_lead: When a taf needs you, it waits in Needs you, and on your watch if you have one. You approve with Face ID or Touch ID, or refuse.
onboarding.control_lead_android: When a taf needs you, it waits in Needs you, and on your watch if you have one. You approve with your screen lock, or refuse.
onboarding.control_lead_mac: When a taf needs you, it waits in Needs you. You approve with Touch ID or on your phone, or refuse.
onboarding.home_lead: Tell Coach what you'd like done, in your own words. It sets the taf up with you and shows you its Card before anything runs.
onboarding.tafs_lead: A taf does one job for you, like support replies, late parcels or lead follow-ups. Ask Coach and it sets one up with you.
